messages.subject: Project Indigo - Disclosure Letter (draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert,

Draft disclosure letter attached, made against the warranties. Specific disclosures cover the CL-PAT-004 co-inventor assignment and recordal, the CL-PAT-008 EP observation, the Meridian FTO item on the SAF module, the existing Stratton Energy SaaS licence (different field), the open-source bill of materials, and the Ravensworth debenture/deed of release. Please acknowledge in the agreed form at signing.

Elena
